title: [storage] free disk under 40 GiB is an alert of its own: disk_low (subject host) on the workspace root's filesystem, cleared at 45 GiB; off by default in the code (the gate's scenarios run on a 15 GiB tmpfs), 40/45 set in the live loop's unit
prompt:
Spawn, objective 204 [storage] (the owner's core metric set of 2026-11-14 18:42: "Free disk: an ALERT only (under 40 GB)"; the lead's rulings of 2026-11-16, split from 182; author rev-f): free disk under 40 GiB is an alert of its own, `disk_low`, beside memory_low and tmpfs_high. Today free disk alerts only through guardrail_out_of_range, under whatever range the Core lines file gives it; 182 makes it a diagnostic with no range. Monitoring only: no gate, integrator or deploy reads it.

Base: live main 6f8ceb8c, merged with live main since (b7e3d31f: one conflict in deploy/systemd/spawn-loop.service, both blocks kept). Independent of 182: no file in common; the two merge cleanly together.

Read first:
- crates/spawn-cli/src/alerts.rs: the module doc's host alerts, Settings, read_host, read_memory and read_tmpfs, crossing;
- crates/spawn-cli/src/disk.rs: free_bytes, the loop's own 20 GiB warning and 2 GiB floor.

What changes (spawn-cli alerts.rs; docs; the loop's unit):
(1) `disk_low`, subject `host`, key `disk_low:<reading ms>`, read every SPAWN_ALERT_CHECK_SECS with the host's other readings (read_disk, new).
   - It fires when the free space of the filesystem holding the workspace root (SPAWN_WORKSPACE_ROOT, the Core lines' free disk; crate::disk::free_bytes) is under SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_LOW_GB GiB.
   - Evidence {path, free_bytes, threshold_bytes, reading_ms}. Text "<path> has <n.n> GiB free, under <low> GiB".
   - One open at a time. It clears at the first reading at or above SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_OK_GB (default 45), cleared evidence {path, free_bytes, threshold_bytes: the margin, reading_ms}. Between the two thresholds a reading does nothing either way (crossing, as memory_low).
   - A restarted loop adopts an open one from the record, as the host alerts do.
   - A df that fails is a line in the loop's log.
(2) Off is the code default: SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_LOW_GB defaults to 0, which disables the check (every gate scenario's workspace root is on a 15 GiB tmpfs, so a 40 GiB default would open the alert in each). Live turns it on in the loop's unit: deploy/systemd/spawn-loop.service sets SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_LOW_GB=40 SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_OK_GB=45. deploy.sh installs no unit files, so the lead applies these two lines to the live unit by hand at landing and posts a check that the running loop has them (the lead's ruling, 2026-11-16).
   - Why not 40 in the code: every gate scenario's workspace root is on the gate's 15 GiB /tmp tmpfs, so a default of 40 would raise disk_low in every scenario that runs the loop. Several of those read every alert: 106 takes the first alert recorded, 057 and 058 render Needs you over all alerts, and check-j12 counts them.
   - Without a workspace root there is nothing to read.
(3) The loop's own disk watch (disk.rs: host.disk records under SPAWN_DISK_WARN_GB, 20 GiB, to the supervisor's digest; dispatch held under SPAWN_DISK_FLOOR_GB, 2 GiB) is apart and unchanged.
(4) The integration tests that zero the host thresholds (integrate/database_tests.rs, the three Monitor runs) zero disk_low_gb too. docs/fleet-architecture.md names the alert.

What stays as it is: every other alert; the Core lines answer (182 moves free disk there); disk.rs.

Tests:
- alerts::tests::free_disk_under_its_threshold_alerts_once_and_clears_at_its_margin (new):
  - 50 GiB, nothing;
  - 39.5 GiB fires one, with its evidence and text;
  - 30 GiB, no second;
  - 42 GiB, held;
  - 45 GiB clears, with the margin in its evidence;
  - 0 reads nothing;
  - a threshold over any disk fires on the real root's reading.
- No test is renamed or dropped.

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/alerts.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/integrate/database_tests.rs, docs/fleet-architecture.md. The owner's part (204-owner.diff): deploy/systemd/spawn-loop.service (the two thresholds), rsi/scenarios/204.sh (new), rsi/backlog/204.json.
Size: fleet about +150 (code about +60, test about +80, docs 4). Owner: 204.sh about 320 lines (089.sh's harness, then 3 checks), the unit +2.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/204.sh, black box through GET /api/alerts, a real `spawn loop` and `spawn serve` on a scratch database (089.sh's harness, the alert step's check every 2 s).
- (1) With SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_LOW_GB=1000000 and SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_OK_GB=2000000 (over any disk): one open disk_low within 60 s, subject host, evidence path = the workspace root, free_bytes a number, threshold_bytes = 1000000 GiB, reading_ms a number. Its text names the path and says "<n.n> GiB free, under 1000000 GiB". Still one after two more checks.
- (2a) The loop started again with SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_LOW_GB=1 and SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_OK_GB=1000000 (above the threshold, under the margin): the alert stays open over three checks.
- (2) The loop started again with SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_LOW_GB=1 and SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_OK_GB=2 (under 2 GiB free under the root is a harness error): it clears within 60 s, its cleared evidence the path, a number of free bytes and threshold_bytes = 2 GiB (the margin). The threshold and the margin differ in (1) and (2), so a record naming the other fails (rev-e's F1).
- (3) The loop started again with neither set: no new disk_low over three checks.
- (4) The margin's default, 45 GiB (rev-b's F1): a new alert opened with LOW 1000000 / OK 2000000, then the loop started again with SPAWN_ALERT_DISK_LOW_GB=1 alone; three checks later, with under 45 GiB free under the root (a gate's tmpfs) it is still open, and with 45 GiB or more it is cleared with threshold_bytes = 45 GiB. A default of 0 clears it either way, with threshold_bytes 0.
On live main (73cbdd8e, and the base 6f8ceb8c) 204.sh exits 1 at (1): no disk_low alert opens.

Verified by: the gate runs 204.sh. Live, once the lead has applied the two lines to the live unit by hand and the running loop has them: with 193 GiB free on / today, no disk_low; under 40 GiB, one alert in Needs you, cleared at 45.
